liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **October 2025 (Wednesday)**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [6]
- **Squid Ink**: rare: 8 archived performances [6]
- **Everyday Magic**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 5 archived performances [6]
- **I Never Could Get Enough**: back after 35 archived shows (1138 days); rare: 4 archived performances [6]
- **I Can Hear Your Love**: rare: 5 archived performances [6]
- **Die For It**: rare: 7 archived performances [6]
- **Hillside Song**: back after 69 archived shows (2514 days); rare: 5 archived performances [6]

## The recordings

- **mmj2025-10-08.vwmule** (recommended): source not stated; 22 songs; 141 min [1]
- **mmj2025-10-08.mk41.flac24**: source not stated; 21 songs; 144 min [2]
- **mmj2025-10-08.mk41.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 144 min [3]
- **mmj2025-10-08.mk4.flac24**: source not stated; 22 songs; 144 min [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2025-10-08.vwmule**: taped by Alex Leary; transferred by Alex Leary; source: Microtech Gefell MV400L/M41 > Sound Devices MixPre-6 (24/48) [1]. Also: Transferred from the MixPre-6 to an iMac, tracked in Sound Studio, and converted to FLAC with xACT [1]
- **mmj2025-10-08.mk41.flac24**: taped by Todd (titotito at gmail); transferred by Todd (titotito at gmail); source: Schoeps mk41 > kc5 > cmc6 > Sound Devices MixPre6i (24/48) [2]
- **mmj2025-10-08.mk41.flac16**: taped by Todd (titotito at gmail); transferred by Todd (titotito at gmail); source: Schoeps mk41 > kc5 > cmc6 > Sound Devices MixPre6i (24/48) [3]
- **mmj2025-10-08.mk4.flac24**: taped by Todd (titotito at gmail); transferred by Todd (titotito at gmail); source: Schoeps mk4 > kcy > RiotBox (+20) > Sound Devices MixPre6i (24/48) [4]

- Poster by Charlie Wagers: [10/8/25 Washington DC Show Poster](https://mymorningjacket.com/products/10-8-25-washington-dc-show-poster) [10]
- Poster by ThreadtShirts: [My Morning Jacket The Anthem In Washington, Dc Oct 08 2025 T-Shirt, hoodie, longsleeve tee](https://threadtshirts.com/product/my-morning-jacket-the-anthem-in-washington-dc-oct-08-2025-t-shirt/) [11]
